atoms.statement: Add a pre-diagnosis readiness gate in Doctor that checks for actual task completion (clean tree, recent commit, or passed tests) and calls Complete-Doctor instead of proceeding with repair diagnosis.
atoms.test: Verify that a ready-but-uncommitted held task under commit_famine closes in exactly one pass via Complete-Doctor.

atoms.statement: Resolve the held task by adding a -ResolveHeldDone switch to Complete-Doctor that marks the held backlog item done/resolved (Set-Idea -Status 'done' + task-outcome-ledger) and clears state to idle, rather than restoring held_task as current_task.
atoms.test: Assert that Complete-Doctor, when called with readiness proven, marks the held backlog item done/resolved and clears state to idle.

atoms.statement: Persist the repair counter’s owner: write doctor_repair_task_id (held task id / current_backlog_id, falling back to a stable hash of held_task) alongside doctor_repair_attempts, and change the missing-stamp/hard-restart resume to reset doctor_repair_attempts ONLY when the resumed held task_id differs from doctor_repair_task_id.
atoms.test: Verify that a simulated missing-stamp restart for the same task_id leaves doctor_repair_attempts non-zero, and resets it if the task_id differs.

atoms.statement: Keep every new field additive (Add-Member ... -Force, doctor_* namespace), reuse Get-DoctorRepairAttemptCount/Get-DoctorStateInt, and gate the close strictly to commit_famine; do not restructure any unrelated state field.
atoms.test: Perform ParseFile validation on lib/doctor.ps1 and conduct a code review to ensure new fields are additive and no unrelated state fields are restructured.

atoms.statement: Ship one atomic self-test (e.g. tools/test-doctor-commit-famine-resolve.ps1) that stubs Get-BridgeRoot/Read-State/Update-State/Set-Idea and asserts: ready-but-uncommitted held task under commit_famine closes in exactly one pass via Complete-Doctor, AND a simulated missing-stamp restart for the same task_id leaves doctor_repair_attempts non-zero; plus a ParseFile gate on doctor.ps1 and a smoke run.
atoms.test: Execute the atomic self-test (e.g. tools/test-doctor-commit-famine-resolve.ps1) asserting one-pass close and counter-survives-restart, plus ParseFile gate on doctor.ps1 and a smoke run.

atoms.statement: Wire the readiness short-circuit into driver/80-loop-preflight.ps1 immediately before the attempt-increment block (line ~230-270): when doctor_active, current_task empty, doctor_reason='commit_famine', and Test-DoctorHeldWorkReady → Complete-Doctor -ResolveHeldDone; continue.
atoms.test: Verify that driver/80-loop-preflight.ps1 correctly calls Complete-Doctor -ResolveHeldDone when doctor_active, current_task empty, doctor_reason='commit_famine', and Test-DoctorHeldWorkReady is true.
